answer: Random peer-review audit stops sybil attacks: each epoch a random draw pairs agents to audit each other's work, so no fake picks its reviewer. Each identity is a graph vertex. Both sides post a 40 POA bond, refunded on passing; a failed audit burns both bonds. The cost gap is a canyon: 100 fakes lock 4,000 POA and face fresh audits, while one honest agent posts 40 POA once and earns a fee, each passed audit adding a layer like a lotus opening.
